properties.name: web3.chains.*.rpc-urls
properties.description: Ordered JSON-RPC endpoint URLs for a chain; takes precedence over rpc-url.

properties.name: web3.rpc.failure-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive endpoint failures before opening its circuit.

properties.name: web3.rpc.open-duration
properties.description: Circuit breaker cooldown before a probe.

properties.name: web3.rpc.request-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for each JSON-RPC HTTP request.

properties.name: web3.rpc.lag-tolerance
properties.description: Maximum tolerated observed block head lag.

properties.name: web3.rpc.<id>
properties.description: Legacy RPC URLs keyed by chain ID. Use web3.chains.<id>.rpc-url instead.
